title: OKX遭黑客攻击：9月24日被盗，3.88亿美元损失谁来承担？
speaker: Gracie Chen

segments.en: Gracie, I have to bring this up. It was a little bit more than a week ago, where you guys were victims of a big hack on your exchange. Can you give us an update on how your operations are at the moment, and in terms of the outflow situation, how is it looking within your customers now?
segments.zh: Gracie，我必须提一下。一周多前，你们交易所遭遇重大黑客事件。能否更新一下目前运营情况，以及客户资金流出情况？

segments.en: Yeah, sure. So on September 24th, UTC time 6.31 p.m., we were hacked by hackers,
segments.zh: 好的。9月24日UTC时间下午6点31分，我们遭到黑客攻击，

segments.en: and there were 388 million in total estimated that were stolen on that day.
segments.zh: 当天估计共有3.88亿美元被盗。
